turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm vegetarian and I lift weights. Am I getting enough protein?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Possibly, but it's worth checking. People who lift often aim for about one and a half to two grams per kilo of body weight a day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I weigh seventy kilos. So that's a lot of beans.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Around a hundred to a hundred and forty grams. Beans help, but eggs, Greek yogurt, tofu and lentils are great too.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I eat eggs and dairy, yeah.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That makes it easier. Cottage cheese and yogurt are very high in protein, and a whey shake can fill gaps.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try logging your food for a few days in an app. You'll see quickly where you stand.
